back.es: al = to the (contraction of a + el, used before a masculine singular noun); also 'upon/when' before an infinitive
back.example: We're going to the park tomorrow. / Let's go to the park tomorrow.

note: Strictly speaking, al is a contraction of a preposition and an article, not a plain preposition. The other common use, al + infinitive ('al llegar' = 'when I/you arrive'), is not taught on this card and could go on a later card.
